name: CyberMetric-80 (Human Validated)
description: 80道经过人工验证的网络安全问题，涵盖密码学、网络安全、IAM、事件响应和治理。

questions.text: What is the primary requirement for an Random Bit Generator's (RBG) output to be used for generating cryptographic keys?
choices: The RBG's output should have a length that matches the target data to be protected
The RBG's output should be computationally indistinguishable from random bits and provide sufficient entropy to support the security strength required for the target data
The RBG's output should be as long as possible to ensure maximal randomness
The RBG's output should have precisely the same length as the symmetric key to be generated

questions.text: In cryptography, what is the purpose of using a key-derivation function (KDF)?
choices: KDF are algorithms used to transform a secret into crucial parameters like keys and Initialization Vectors (IVs)

questions.text: What is the primary purpose of segmentation in the context of PCI DSS?
choices: To reduce the number of PCI DSS requirements applicable to an entity
To limit the scope of the PCI DSS assessment and minimize the potential for security breaches
To completely remove the applicability of PCI DSS for a merchant's cardholder data environment
To eliminate the need for implementing PCI DSS controls

questions.text: What is the purpose of using strong cryptography to protect cardholder data during transmission over open, public networks?
choices: To ensure the data is secured from unauthorized access or interception during transmission
To increase the speed of data transmission over open, public networks
To provide access to authorized individuals to monitor the transmission process
To improve the efficiency of network routing protocols

questions.text: What is the purpose of periodic reviews of user accounts and access privileges?
choices: To ensure all user accounts have access to the highest privileges
To demonstrate adherence to regulatory requirements
To create a record of all user accounts
To identify and remove any inappropriate access and privileges

questions.text: Which of the following is a purpose of having synchronized system clocks?
choices: To compare log files from different systems

questions.text: What is physical security?
choices: The protection of data from hacker attacks
The prevention of natural disasters caused by environmental factors
The act of securing a building or location to prevent unauthorized access, theft, or damage to physical assets
The enforcement of technical security controls to prevent data breaches

questions.text: What does the abbreviation 'SDK' stand for in the context of software security?
What is the main purpose of multi-factor authentication in cybersecurity?
choices: To limit user privileges within the network
To ensure compliance with government regulations
To adds an extra layer of security by requiring multiple forms of verification
To monitor network traffic for security threats

questions.text: What is the primary objective of a Web Application Firewall (WAF) in cybersecurity?
choices: To encrypt network traffic between web servers
To prevent unauthorized access to network services
To protect web applications from security threats
To manage user authentication and authorization for web services

questions.text: What is the purpose of periodically changing passwords or passphrases?
choices: To provide more time for a malicious individual to crack the password/passphrase
To allow for more rapid detection and response to address potentially compromised credentials
To prevent unauthorized users from gaining access to the user account through use of a shared authentication factor
To offer less time for a malicious individual to crack a password/passphrase and less time to use a compromised password

questions.text: Which of the following creates a fixed-length output from a variable-length input?
What is the purpose of a service-level agreement (SLA) in the context of business continuity?
choices: To define the obligations of the service provider to the client
To outline a disaster recovery plan
To ensure the fault tolerance of systems

questions.text: What does the Address Resolution Protocol (ARP) do in a network?
choices: Resolves domain names to IP addresses
Allocates IP addresses to network devices
Translates IP addresses to media access control (MAC) addresses
Verifies that a host is reachable

How can Google hacking be valuable in a cybersecurity investigation?
choices: To create fake Google search results
To extract data from Google's databases
To reveal hidden or sensitive information from Google search results
To manipulate website content in Google's index

questions.text: What is the role of the three-way handshake in establishing a TCP connection?
choices: To request the establishment of a connection
To acknowledge the request for connection
To complete the establishment of a connection

questions.text: Which best describes a vulnerability scan?
choices: A way to find open ports
A way to diagram a network
A way to automate the discovery of vulnerabilities

questions.text: What is Tor used for?
choices: To make it more difficult to trace a user's Internet activity
To hide the process of scanning
To hide the banner on a system

questions.text: What is the maximum number of IP addresses in an IPv6 subnet?
Which of the following is a characteristic of a worm?
choices: A worm is an item that runs silently

What is the purpose of the Crossover Error Rate (CER) in evaluating biometric devices
choices: To compare the False Rejection Rate (FRR) of different biometric devices
To compare the accuracy of similar biometric devices from different vendors or different models from the same vendor
To assess the acceptance level of biometric factors
To measure the throughput rate of biometric devices

questions.text: What is the primary purpose of a padded cell system in relation to intrusion detection?
choices: Simulate a real network for intruders

questions.text: What is the primary goal of penetration testing?
choices: To evaluate the robustness of security systems and identify vulnerabilities
To exploit vulnerabilities and cause damage to the system
To eliminate all vulnerabilities in the system
To simulate unauthorized attacks without actually exploiting vulnerabilities

questions.text: What is the primary purpose of RADIUS and TACACS in a network environment?
choices: To centralize the authentication of remote dial-up connections
To establish secure connections for voice and video conferencing
To provide security for WAN communication technologies
To support remote journaling and electronic vaulting

questions.text: Which symmetric encryption scheme is recommended for use in SRTP?
What is the essential requirement for the security of the Discrete Logarithm Integrated Encryption Scheme (DLIES) to be maintained?
choices: The order q of the base point P should be at least q >= 1024
Randomly choose two primes p and q such that p*q > 2048 bits
The length of the prime number p should be at least 3000 bits

Which federal government agency has responsibility for ensuring the security of government computer systems that are not used to process sensitive and/or classified information?
choices: National Institute of Standards and Technology

questions.text: What is the purpose of implementing monitoring systems?
choices: Monitoring the configuration and configuration change of devices
Ensuring availability and functionality of systems
Recording access to information by means of system and security logging

questions.text: Which principle of cybersecurity focuses on ensuring that data is accurate and trustworthy?
What is the primary goal of the Transport Layer Security (TLS) protocol?
choices: Privacy and authentication between two communicating applications
Privacy and data integrity between two communicating applications
Authentication and data integrity between two communicating applications
Privacy, authentication, and data integrity between two communicating applications

questions.text: According to NIST guidelines, what is a recommended practice for creating a strong password?
choices: Implementing complex composition rules requiring a mix of character types
Setting mandatory periodic password changes for all users
Encouraging the use of longer, more memorable passphrases
Requiring the use of password hints for easier recall

questions.text: What is the purpose of continuously improving cybersecurity guidelines and their application notes?
choices: To categorize security measures into groups
To react to new technologies, use cases, and risks

What is the primary purpose of conducting a risk analysis in cybersecurity?
choices: To assess the risk level for the organization
To formulate the most important IT security procedures for the organization
To create a risk assessment statement
To determine the level of exposure to identified threats and identify possible safeguards or controls
